notes.title: May 14 2024 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

Here's what's been changed this update:

[list]
[*] Steam Cloud has been enabled for windows users
[*] Fixed the final boss pushing players under the map
[*] Fixed the final boss teleporting randomly while using a certain lengthy attack
[*] Fixed key rebind text to show properly on the prompts at the top of the screen
[*] Fixed the camera randomly jittering while the player is dashing
[*] Game will spawn a random 1h weapon if the player loads with no weapons equipped
[*] Fixed bug causing character customization to not apply to new characters beyond the first
[*] Added the ability to delete save files
[*] Fixed bug causing enemy to jump out of the map
[*] Enemy colliders now disable when they die, allowing the player to move through freely. 
[/list]

notes.title: May 8 2024 Hotfix Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Optimized and fixed missing textures
[*] Reduced second boss wind attack pushback to reduce wall clipping
[*] Implemented fixes to reduce chance of enemies falling through the map
[*] Enemy can no longer block poison or bleeding damage
[*] Tutorial can now be sped through slightly quicker by pressing the menu or jump button in the inventory tutorial section
[*] Equipping items now pushes the old item out of the slot instead of stacking
[/list]

notes.title: May 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Hey arena fighters!

As you know, the game has finally launched! With that, I just want to say a tremendously huge thank you to everyone who's played the game. As hard as the mosquitos fought to keep you all down, you fought back harder. It's been amazing to see people play. You all continue to amaze me with unique builds and playstyles. Seriously, from the bottom of my heart, thank you. 

Overall the game has shown to be pretty stable. A few outlier bugs (hehe) remain, but for the most part, it's been solid. I will be looking into these bugs and trying to fix them in an upcoming patch. 

A few bugs of note:

[list]
[*] Enemies falling through the map - I've known about this for a while. It's just a big task to fix, honestly. 
[*] Character customization bugs on characters made beyond the first
[*] Texture issues for a few weapons
[*] Clipping through the map due to specific enemy attacks
[*] Camera bugs with specific movement 
[*] Enemies blocking poison and bleed damage
[*] Some inventory bugs related to physics
[/list]

Once again, thank you so much for everything. It's a simple little game but the reception has been wild.

notes.title: Forest of Tails: Arena Release Date Announced!

notes.title: March 2024 Game Update
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

Just giving a quick update and some great news overall. As always, thanks for taking the time to read and follow the updates.

[b]Development[/b]

THE GAME IS DONE. 

Yes you read that correctly. Development of the game is totally complete. The game goes all the way up to wave 200 and includes several bosses with a big finale at the end. There are a few tweaks and changes I've been making as I've been doing some balance testing for the game. I'm pretty happy with where it stands now. So what does this mean? 

Next steps: I have some internal testers going through the game to see if there are any more glaring issues. As with anything, there will always be some minor issues but overall I don't think there are any game-breaking issues I have to worry about (Fingers crossed). I have internal builds loaded into Steam that are working great, so I just need to set up the release date and make the big announcement. 

[b]Other Good News[/b]

All of the fake game websites and malware has been taken down. I don't doubt there are still some floating around but hopefully this means I don't have to worry about everyone being tempted into some fake version of the game. As always, the game will be released on Steam so don't fall for any trickery. 

[b]Final Notes[/b]

Thanks for following the development. It means a lot for this simple little game. Keep your eyes open for the release date that I'll be announcing soon.

Make sure to follow me on other social platforms too! That's where I post videos and images as well.

https://www.instagram.com/daylawngames/

https://twitter.com/DayLawnGames

notes.title: February 2024 Game Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, 

Decided to post my updates for the game here. Figured it's the best place for transparency and helps communication as I'm pretty bad at it. This will be brief I promise!

[b]Development[/b]

It's coming along really well. The goal of the game has been to reach 200 waves with a final boss. My original timeline was to launch for last Christmas but I extended the deadline to add more bosses and to expand on the enemies to make them more fun. I'm now at Wave 180 and all I need to do is finish one more enemy and them put together the last boss of the game. Very excited to get this into everyone's hands! This likely means I'll be releasing in the next two months if all goes well. 

The game looks relatively more polished than the trailer but for the sake of time, I won't be updating it to showcase the updated graphics.

My last thought is about adding an endless mode after wave 200 for players who want to keep sinking their teeth in. It'll likely be a ham-fisted feature and not well balanced but it'll allow endless playability post-game.

[b]Bad News / Malware[/b]

Seems like someone snagged the domain for www.ForestOfTails.com and is spreading malware. I'm doing everything in my power to have the website taken down but so far I've made no progress. It's frustrating but I will continue to try to solve the problem. The game will be released on Steam so please please please do not go to the website to try and snag the game early. I'm worried about releasing the game while the website is still active but it's becoming something out of my control. 

[b]Final Notes[/b]

Make sure to follow me on other social platforms too! That's where I post videos and images as well.
